CPI ABI type definitions, VM layout constants, and caller account translation state.

# Purpose
Defines the data layouts used by the virtual machine CPI syscall interface. It provides C ABI and Rust ABI structure definitions for instruction data, account metadata, account info, and helper layouts for `Rc<RefCell<T>>` and Rust `Vec` values. The file also defines size and alignment constants for each type so the VM and syscall handlers can validate untrusted input and access fields with the expected memory layout. The `fd_vm_cpi_caller_account_t` type stores cached translation state for caller account handling during CPI.
